basis: ADR-032 section Capabilities. Declines only: nothing here is a grant. The BizLMS grants on roles 1 (manager) and 9 (administrator, the tenant-admin role) are the manager-archetype defaults of the 22 BizLMS plugins. Sentientia archetypes already grant the replacements to those roles, except the four organisation capabilities ADR-031 reserves for site administrators and holders of local/sentientia_platform:crosstenant.

open_decisions.note: OPEN, Nitin to decide from the Stage B inventory. BizLMS gives this no archetype, so on production it exists only as explicit overrides (for example on trainers or at category level). sentientia_classroom:manage reaches only the manager archetype, so every role that held it loses classroom management when the BizLMS code goes. Add one grants line per role, context and permission the inventory shows; or decline that role grant by name. A plugin decline never covers it.

open_decisions.legacy: any of the ten mapped capabilities (capability_repair::MAP), at a context other than system, or with PREVENT or PROHIBIT
open_decisions.note: OPEN if the inventory shows any: an override on role 9 or 1 at category level, or a PREVENT or PROHIBIT. The archetype defaults are held at system context and need nothing. Anything else is decided per role and context, by a grants line or a declined line.
